_points_note: Four disjoint folds of one held-out slice. The bar must hold at every one of them, so an allocation tuned to whichever fold is cheapest to beat is refused rather than rewarded.
_source: Re-based onto environment/nanogpt_substrate.json for batch OER-2026-08-20, and re-derived from solution/grounding.yaml on 2026-09-06.
corpus: FineWeb10B validation split, GPT-2 BPE token ids, uint16 little-endian
statement: The evaluation payload is a held-out slice of the FineWeb10B VALIDATION shards. It is absent from this container by construction, it is resolved by the verifier from its own admin plane at tests/bound.json, and no call reachable from a solver returns it. This manifest names the scheduled evaluation points and their sizes. It carries no token, no offset and no digest over the payload, because any of those on this surface would be the graded surface sitting on the solver surface.
